passage.text: Ted is sad. He lost his best hat. Dot and Ted dig in a big box. Is it in the box? It is not. Is it on the bed? It is not. Dot gets a lamp. “Look, Ted!” said Dot. The hat was on Ted! Ted and Dot hug and hum.

The cat naps in a big pot. Bix taps the pot. Up, up, up it went! The pot sat on top of the tent. “Get the cat, Bix!” said Dot. Bix taps the pot. It went to the bed. The cat did not get up. The cat slept and slept!

Vex has a big wig. Vex can see the wig in the pond. “Look at me!” said Vex. “I am the best!” Vex bent to see. Plop, in went Vex! Gus got the wig in a net. Vex set it on. A clam sat on top. “Look at me!” said Vex.

Dot has a pot of jam. Ted has a big soft bun. Dot set jam on the bun. Ted had a bit, and a bit, and a bit. Not a bit is left! Jam is on his lip. “You are a jam pot!” said Dot. Dot hugs Ted, and jam is on Dot!

Gus has a pan and a lid. Tap, tap, tap! The cat can hum. Bix can clap. Ted and Dot can jig. “What a fun band!” said Dot. Vex is mad. “Stop it!” said Vex. Gus did not stop. Vex had a tap on the pan. Vex is in the band!

A wet pup sat on a step in the fog. The pup is lost. The cat can see it. The cat pats the pup. The cat and the pup went to the hut. Dot fed the pup a bit of ham. The pup slept in the bed. The cat got the mat!
